name: Add PR Comment
description: Add a comment to a pull request

message-path.description: A path or list of paths to a file to print as a message instead of a string.

message-id.description: An optional id to use for this message.

refresh-message-position.description: If a message with the same id, this option allow to refresh the position of the message to be the last one posted.

repo-token.description: A GitHub token for API access. Defaults to {{ github.token }}.

status.description: A job status for status headers. Defaults to {{ job.status }}.

message-success.description: Override the message when a run is successful.

message-failure.description: Override the message when a run fails.

message-cancelled.description: Override the message when a run is cancelled.

message-skipped.description: Override the message when a run is skipped.

issue.description: Override the message when a run is cancelled.

update-only.description: Only update the comment if it already exists.

preformatted.description: Treat message text (from a file or input) as pre-formatted and place it in a codeblock.

find.description: A regular expression to find for replacement. Multiple lines become individual regular expressions.

replace.description: A replacement to use, overrides the message. Multple lines can replace same-indexed find patterns.
